title: T12 localization command controller and integrated error-state contract

modules.name: localization_command_ctrl

interfaces.command: ready/valid semantic transaction emitted only after T05 frame validation
interfaces.observation_staging: indexed write port followed by atomic LOAD_OBSERVATIONS commit
interfaces.response: held response descriptor consumed by a later packet adapter
interfaces.result: persistent summary plus an idle-only synchronous final-vertex read window

behavior: Accept fixed-configuration, observation-load, start, query, result-read, and abort commands.
Run initial polygon load, two half-plane clips per observation, and final exhaustive diameter in order.
Maintain the current vertex buffer and count while exclusively arbitrating both RAM ports.
Lift quantization, parallel, arithmetic, capacity, timeout, illegal-state, and abort conditions into protocol result flags.
Keep a completed result stable until a new valid observation set, new job, abort, or reset changes its validity.
constraints: The upstream payload adapter must write only CRC-validated observations before issuing LOAD_OBSERVATIONS.
Observation count is limited to 2 through 20 and each phase value is already reduced to 18 bits.
SET_CONFIG asserts command_config_matches_i only for the frozen 28-byte T03 numeric contract.
Only ABORT and read-only queries are accepted without a BUSY error during computation.
No synthesis, implementation timing, or board-level claims are implied by module simulation.
corner_cases: START before configuration reports parameter error.
Invalid observation counts do not modify the active observation set.
An empty clip result skips remaining constraints and returns an EMPTY result.
ABORT resets all child engines, invalidates the result, and permits a clean restart.
A watchdog expiration makes the result INVALID and sets the timeout flag.
verification_cases: Reject invalid configuration, invalid observation count, early START, and repeated START while busy.
Match the T02 bit-exact four-vertex normal result and diameter.
Return a bit-exact empty result for incompatible bearings.
Read one final vertex through the idle result window.
Abort during initial polygon loading and successfully execute the next job.

timing_diagrams.title: Accepted localization job
timing_diagrams.description: A START acknowledgement precedes load, repeated constraint/clip phases, diameter, and persistent result-ready state.
